lines.start_saviour: Third waking. Some called you saviour.
lines.start_invented_voice: I remember your voice. Or I invented it.
lines.start_hero_lied: I told you you were a hero. Maybe I lied.
lines.start_bright_or_crashed: You fell from somewhere bright. Or you crashed.
lines.start_chose_return: Whatever you were, you chose to come back.
